notes: Earlier judgement (Flashpoint = Rockstar, Radway Road) is WRONG. Flashpoint Swindon was a separate bouldering gym at Unit 30b, Techno Trading Estate, Bramble Rd, SN2 8HB (its own site, archived Feb-Jul 2024; our pin is Swindon town centre, wrong either way). Rockstar's official 'Flashpoint & Freedog Swindon Transition' FAQ says Flashpoint Swindon joined Rockstar, 'all three centres will remain open', brand gradually transitions, and names the sites 'Rockstar Climbing (IO)' and 'Rockstar Bouldering (Techno)' / 'Techno (formerly Flashpoint)'. That is why flashpointswindon.com redirects to rockstarclimbing.co.uk. So: rename this record to Rockstar Bouldering (Techno), move it to Bramble Road (needs geocode; I may not geocode), and add Rockstar Climbing Centre (IO, Radway Road) as its own gym if not already on the map (I cannot check the database; dedupe first, coordinates from location_check are for this IO site). Name wording is the FAQ's own phrase 'Rockstar Bouldering (Techno)'; Rockstar has not yet published a dedicated Techno page, so alternative is to keep 'Flashpoint Swindon' until it does. No official hours/price found for the Techno site (the Rockstar footer hours are the IO site's), so not filled. Types for Techno unchanged (bouldering). Rockstar IO has a Bouldering Arena plus High Walls Arena (rope), Crux Cafe & Bar, climbing shop, shoe hire £4; lead climbing not stated beyond 'Learn to Lead' classes, so only top-rope listed. Web search was used only to find these pages (a third-party snippet gave the Bramble Road address; confirmed on the archived official Flashpoint site).
